condition.artipelago.catch_in_battle.des: Checks whether the catch attempt is happening during a battle.
ftbquests.quest.tracking.tooltip: Which progress store this quest writes to by default. Tasks can override this individually.
ftbquests.task.tracking.tooltip: Which progress store this task writes to. Inherit uses the parent quest's Tracking Scope.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.block_break.va: How many matching blocks the player has to break.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.block_break.bl: Match one block id or one block tag. Leave the value blank to count any block.
Block id, for example minecraft:oak_log. Leave blank to count any block.
Block tag id, with or without the leading #, for example minecraft:logs. Leave blank to count any block.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.fish.value.too: How many matching catches the player has to make.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.fish.item_filt: Match one item id or one item tag. Leave the value blank to count any catch.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.fish.item.tool: Item id, for example minecraft:cod. Leave blank to count any catch.
Item tag id, with or without the leading #, for example minecraft:fishes. Leave blank to count any catch.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.fish.filter_bi: When on, only catches whose bobber is in the selected biome or biome tag count.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.customer_trans: How many matching items or coins the customer has to trade.
Sold items = items the shop sold to you (your purchases). Bought items = items the shop bought from you (your sales). Coins are from your point of view.
Optional filter on what the shop sold. Any imposes no condition.
Item id the shop must have sold, for example minecraft:oak_log.
Item tag id the shop must have sold, with or without the leading #.
Optional filter on what the shop bought. Any imposes no condition.
Item id the shop must have bought, for example minecraft:oak_log.
Item tag id the shop must have bought, with or without the leading #.
When on, admin shops count. When off, only player-owned shops count.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.merchant_trans: How many matching items or coins customers have to trade at your shops.
Sold items = items your shop sold to customers. Bought items = items your shop bought from customers. Coins are from the merchant's point of view.
Optional filter on what your shop sold. Any imposes no condition.
Item id your shop must have sold, for example minecraft:oak_log.
Item tag id your shop must have sold, with or without the leading #.
Optional filter on what your shop bought. Any imposes no condition.
Item id your shop must have bought, for example minecraft:oak_log.
Item tag id your shop must have bought, with or without the leading #.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.trade_item.val: How many matching items the player has to trade.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.trade_item.cou: Trade away = items you gave. Trade for = items you received. Either counts both sides.
ftbquests.task.artipelago.trade_item.ite: Match any item, one item id or one item tag. The field that does not apply is dimmed.
Item tag id, with or without the leading #, for example minecraft:logs.
